description: Unofficial Mash Burnedead fan-art companion inspired by the early Mashle school uniform. Original fully clothed animation features a soft cream-puff model, a flexible toy spoon and hollow foam books. The physical left-eye mark stays on its proper side across independently drawn right, left and front running poses. Nine distinct states include calm prop interactions and a compact hop. No endorsement implied.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
